---
title: "Flag weather retrospective"
subtitle: "Storm events and seasonal climate synopses for Flagstaff, Arizona"
---

This site documents precipitation events in Flagstaff and the atmospheric patterns that produced them, using the City of Flagstaff rain-gauge network, nearby SNOTEL sites, the Flagstaff airport record and ERA5 reanalysis.

- **[Events](events/index.qmd)**: one page per rain or snow event, with gauge-network totals and maps of moisture transport, the jet stream and 500-hPa heights.
- **[Seasons](seasons/index.qmd)**: seasonal synopses: temperature and precipitation against normal, the season's events, and the ocean and atmosphere patterns behind them.
- **[Network](network.qmd)**: the gauges and SNOTEL sites used here.
- **[Methods](methods.qmd)**: data sources, definitions and thresholds.

::: {.callout-note}
The site is under construction. Event and seasonal pages for autumn 2026 are being added.
:::
